name: Deepavali Lamps & Rangoli
summary: Twelve clay diyas, a round geometric rangoli and two hanging marigold garlands.
description: Original twelve-diya display with wide ivory-and-gold static flames, an included 2 x 2 m square floor, a raised 2.4 m round three-colour geometric rangoli, and two supported marigold garlands of 21 layered flower heads each. Hollow clay bowls, wicks and a freestanding two-post frame; no text, brands, religious figures or external assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / Codex-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python; three plain shared materials; no external models, images, textures, fonts or scripts.
accuracy_notes: Measured export dimensions are X width, Y height, Z depth. The included 2 x 2 m square floor spans X/Z [-1, 1], with its underside at Y=0 and top at Y=0.012 m. The 2.4 m round, 8 mm rangoli rests on it at Y=0.012 to 0.020 m and intentionally overhangs the square edges. All twelve lamps fit inside the square and rest at Y=0.020 m. Two support feet sit on the square floor; posts carry a crossbar with four interlocking garland loops. No host ceiling attachment is required. The host supplies a level ground plane at Y=0. Flames are static meshes without emitted lights or simulation. Physical rigging, devices, WebKit and full-mall performance are not verified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials created for the owner project. No third-party assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
material_notes: Three shared opaque materials and three delivery meshes. Terracotta: bowls, wicks and support frame; MarigoldGold: layered flower heads, oil and flame cores; RiceIvory: square floor, flame bodies, hangers and mosaic accents. The closed rangoli is tessellated without coplanar overlays.
